title: smime-tree/encrypt.rs: build_mime not annotated #[must_use]
description:
Why this exists: smime_tree/src/encrypt.rs contains fn build_mime which constructs and returns the MIME envelope bytes. This is a pure function — it takes inputs, produces a Vec<u8>, and has no side effects. The Rust standard practice for pure functions that return meaningful values is to annotate them #[must_use] so that accidentally discarding the return value produces a compile warning.

What goes wrong: a call to build_mime(...) whose return value is silently dropped produces no warning. This is unlikely in practice (the function is private and always called at a single site that uses its return value), but the annotation documents intent and guards against future refactors that might accidentally drop the result.

Location: smime-tree/src/encrypt.rs, fn build_mime.

Fix: add #[must_use] to fn build_mime.
close_reason: build_mime is private. #[must_use] on private functions has no external benefit.
